cohort: 106 women aged 20-35 years undergoing delivery at term
finding: Cord blood endocan levels were significantly lower in neonates born by elective caesarean section with general anaesthesia compared to those born by spontaneous vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Cord blood endocan levels were significantly lower in neonates born by elective caesarean section with general anaesthesia compared to those born by spontaneous vaginal delivery.
